title: Python for AI Engineering: Build a RAG Pipeline from Scratch
concept: Build every stage of retrieval-augmented generation in plain Python 3.14: chunking, deduplication, BM25 and hybrid retrieval, context packing with citations, and offline evaluation.
description: A hands-on course for developers who ship LLM features and need the answers to be right. Each lesson starts from a production incident in a support assistant - answers cut mid-sentence, three copies of the same paragraph in the context, error codes the vector search cannot find, prompts that overflow the context window - and fixes it with the standard library only: overlapping chunks, shingle-based deduplication, BM25, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, token-budgeted context packing with t-string templates, and recall@k / MRR to prove a change helps before it ships.

lessons.title: Hybrid search with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Packing context under a token budget, with citations
